+def shrink_traced_types(traces: Iterable[CallTrace], max_typed_dict_size: int
+    ) ->Tuple[Dict[str, type], Optional[type], Optional[type]]:
+    if not traces:
+        return {}, None, None
+    
+    # Collect all argument types and return types from traces
+    arg_types_list = []
+    return_types = []
+    yield_types = []
+    
+    for trace in traces:
+        # Shrink the argument types for this trace
+        shrunk_args = shrink_types(list(trace.arg_types.values()), max_typed_dict_size)
+        # Map back to parameter names
+        arg_types = dict(zip(trace.arg_types.keys(), shrunk_args))
+        arg_types_list.append(arg_types)
+        
+        # Collect return and yield types
+        if trace.return_type is not None:
+            return_types.append(trace.return_type)
+        if trace.yield_type is not None:
+            yield_types.append(trace.yield_type)
+    
+    # Combine all argument types by taking the union/shrink
+    combined_arg_types = {}
+    if arg_types_list:
+        # For each parameter, combine all types from different traces
+        all_param_names = set().union(*[args.keys() for args in arg_types_list])
+        for param_name in all_param_names:
+            param_types = [args.get(param_name) for args in arg_types_list if param_name in args]
+            if param_types:
+                # Shrink the types for this parameter across all traces
+                shrunk_param_types = shrink_types(param_types, max_typed_dict_size)
+                combined_arg_types[param_name] = shrunk_param_types[0] if shrunk_param_types else None
+    
+    # Shrink return types
+    shrunk_return_type = None
+    if return_types:
+        shrunk_return_type = shrink_types(return_types, max_typed_dict_size)[0] if return_types else None
+    
+    # Shrink yield types
+    shrunk_yield_type = None
+    if yield_types:
+        shrunk_yield_type = shrink_types(yield_types, max_typed_dict_size)[0] if yield_types else None
+    
+    return combined_arg_types, shrunk_return_type, shrunk_yield_type
